svg.text: The frame: gi_threads against gi less its push
The median over frames 2 to 64 at the view's camera, then over three runs; every gi_threads picture equal to gi's, byte for byte.
A glTF file's load: seconds to the first picture
One P150A, 24 CPUs of the host, 2026-11-28; cold draws without the far field, built on the host after it.
